name: app-lavender-booking-form-with-brush-note-callout
title: Booking Form with Brush-Note Callout
whatItIs: A lavender slide, Booking Experience, with a large phone showing a personal-information form under a three-step tracker, a torn white brush note 'Review Before You Book' linked by a thin line, and another phone peeking below.
whatItMeans: Connector lines and a hand-torn note explain a form's purpose without cluttering the UI.
techniques: Elbow connector line from the phone to a callout
Progress tracker dots at the top of the flow
Rounded white inputs on soft lilac
Second device cropped at the bottom to imply a sequence

vocabulary.definition: A line linking a UI area to an explanatory note.
A rough-edged paper shape used as an annotation.
A visual showing the current step in a multi-step flow.
